name: KpiRow
srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `KpiRow` defaults `kpis`, `runs`, `loading` and adds loading/error states, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `KpiRow` holds 5 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 5 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization. Written by scripts/reconcile-record-src.cjs --annotate.
whenUse: A 6-up KPI stat grid: commits, PRs merged, net lines, CI pass rate, review latency, contributors.
whenNot: A single stat — use StatCard directly.
